Title: Azure Automation: Graphical and PowerShell runbooks added to Gallery

Body.Content:
To help with common automation tasks, the Azure Automation team released four new graphical runbooks and two PowerShell runbooks to the Automation gallery. There are graphical and PowerShell runbooks for starting and stopping Azure V2/ARM virtual machines, in addition to graphical runbooks for cleaning up empty Azure ARM resource groups and for moving files between Azure Classic VMs. You can find the runbooks in the Automation Gallery in the Azure portal and also at these sites: Graphical:
  • Start Azure ARM VMs
  • Stop Azure ARM VMs
  • Find (and Delete) Empty Resource Groups Graphical Runbook
  • Copy File Between Azure Classic VMs Graphical Runbook
PowerShell:
  • Start Azure V2 VMs
  • Stop Azure V2 VMs
